customMethods.name: reSize
customMethods.script:
if self.view.custom.reSize:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('cancelConfigs',True)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('selectFrame',{'selected': True})
		self.view.custom.reSize=True
		self.view.custom.relocate=False
		self.view.custom.connect=False
		self.view.custom.allConnect=False
		self.view.custom.areaRelocate=False

customMethods.name: connect
customMethods.script:
if self.view.custom.connect:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('cancelConfigs',True)
	elif self.view.params.typeID!="container":
		system.perspective.sendMessage('selectFrame',{'selected': True})
		self.view.custom.connect= True
		self.view.custom.allConnect=True
		self.view.custom.reSize=False
		self.view.custom.relocate=False
		self.view.custom.areaRelocate=False
